en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Rabie, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Take the pebbles (for pelting) Al-Jamarah, from Jam’a (place of assembly near Muzdalifah); and if you were to take from your departure in Mina, it would suffice you’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Rib’iy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Take the pebbles for al-Jamar from Jam‘ and if you take them from your lodging in Mina’ is also sufficient.’”
